design.name: 白泽
design.brief: The legendary sage beast Baize, who knows every demon in the world, as a mythic companion: a majestic lion-goat body. Snow-white fur ONLY on the flowing mane, beard and chest; the body, legs and face mask are DEEP slate-indigo (the dark colour block) patterned with pale gold cloud markings, so it reads with strong value contrast and never as an all-white shape. Two curved dark-gold horns, a glowing red-gold third eye on its forehead, a row of small golden eyes along each flank, gold cloud ornaments on the shoulders, a jade talisman pendant at the chest, and dark cloud-shaped fur tufts at the hooves. Noble, wise and radiant; shown rearing with its third eye blazing.
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing pose on all four legs
design.turnaround_pose: , legs straight and slightly apart, head facing forward, mouth closed, the tufted tail hanging down behind and clearly separate from the hind legs; NO light rays, aura or sparkles, the eyes only glow
design.turnaround_digits: each leg ends in a clearly split two-toed hoof; the horns, mane and tail are never cut off by the frame.
modeled: lion-goat body with white mane and beard
row of small flank eyes (emissive gold)
